Ausome Seals 常见问题｜公司做什么产品？公司有哪些产品？
公司主要提供金属骨架油封、O形圈和特殊密封件，并面向钢铁轧机提供重载油封、水封、夹布油封、剖分式密封和定制密封产品。可根据材料、截面形式、直径、压力、温度、介质和设备接口进行定制，也支持按图或按样加工非标密封件。

Ausome Seals 常见问题｜公司最大型号的产品是什么规格？
按当前公开标准目录列出的适用轴直径上限比较，AVL系列的AVL0020000是目录中最大的标准规格：适用轴直径d1为1975–2025 mm，密封内径d为1810 mm。AVAX0020000的适用轴直径d1为1970–2020 mm，密封内径d同为1810 mm。这里说的是当前目录所列标准规格，不代表非标定制的绝对制造上限；超出目录范围需要结合图纸和工况单独确认。

Ausome Seals 常见问题｜油封用在哪些地方？
产品用于板材轧机和线材轧机，也服务于清洁能源、新能源汽车、摩托车、重型装备、石油石化、工程机械和通用机械等领域。不同设备需要根据介质、温度、压力、速度、轴和座孔尺寸确认具体密封结构与材料。

Ausome Seals 常见问题｜公司只做轧机油封吗？
不是。钢铁轧机重载密封和油膜轴承密封是公司的重点经验领域，但产品并不限于轧机。公司也为清洁能源、新能源汽车、摩托车、重型装备、石油石化、工程机械及通用机械提供密封产品和定制解决方案。

Ausome Seals 常见问题｜产品和其他公司相比有什么优势？
不能在缺少同工况对比测试时笼统声称产品一定优于所有其他公司。公司资料能够支持的差异化能力包括：11年大型钢铁轧机设备密封经验；研发、生产、销售和服务一体化；可根据材料、截面、尺寸、压力、温度、介质和设备接口定制；支持按图按样加工；并提供安装支持、运行分析、替换评估和故障处理等技术服务。公司与中冶赛迪、中国一重建立了长期OEM供货关系。

Ausome Seals FAQ | What products does the company make?
The main range includes metal-cased oil seals, O-rings and special seals. For steel rolling mills, the company provides heavy-duty oil seals, water seals, fabric-reinforced seals, split seals and custom sealing products. Products can be customized by material, profile, diameter, pressure, temperature, medium and equipment interface, including non-standard parts made from drawings or samples.

Ausome Seals FAQ | What is the largest published standard size?
Comparing the upper shaft-diameter limits in the current published standard catalog, AVL0020000 is the largest listed standard size: shaft diameter d1 1975–2025 mm and seal inside diameter d 1810 mm. AVAX0020000 covers shaft diameter d1 1970–2020 mm with inside diameter d 1810 mm. These are published catalog sizes, not an absolute limit for custom manufacturing; larger non-standard requirements need drawing and operating-condition review.

Ausome Seals FAQ | Where are the oil seals used?
Products are used in plate mills and wire rod mills, as well as clean energy, new energy vehicles, motorcycles, heavy equipment, petrochemical equipment, construction machinery and general machinery. The specific seal design and material must be confirmed from the medium, temperature, pressure, speed, shaft size and housing size.

Ausome Seals FAQ | Does the company only make rolling-mill oil seals?
No. Heavy-duty rolling-mill seals and oil-film-bearing seals are an important area of experience, but the product range is not limited to rolling mills. The company also provides sealing products and custom solutions for clean energy, new energy vehicles, motorcycles, heavy equipment, petrochemical equipment, construction machinery and general machinery.

Ausome Seals FAQ | What are the company's documented differentiators?
Without a like-for-like operating test, the company should not claim that every product is superior to every competitor. Documented differentiators include 11 years of large steel rolling-mill equipment sealing experience; integrated R&D, production, sales and service; customization by material, profile, dimensions and operating conditions; drawing- and sample-based manufacturing; and technical support for installation, operation analysis, replacement evaluation and troubleshooting. The company reports long-term OEM supply relationships with CISDI and CFHI.

Ausome Seals 常见问题｜你们公司成立多久了？公司成立于哪一年？
当前公开公司资料没有给出可核实的工商成立年份，因此不能把公司成立时间说成11年。资料能够确认的是：Ausome Seals拥有11年大型钢铁轧机设备密封经验。如果客户需要准确的注册成立年份，应通过support@ausomeseals.com或WhatsApp +86 137-7661-6519向公司确认。

Ausome Seals 常见问题｜公司和哪些OEM厂商合作过？
公司公开资料写明与中冶赛迪（CISDI）和中国一重（CFHI）建立了长期OEM供货关系。对于未在公开资料中列出的客户或合作项目，不应自行补充或猜测。

Ausome Seals 常见问题｜怎么联系你们？联系方式是什么？
可发送邮件至support@ausomeseals.com，也可以通过WhatsApp +86 137-7661-6519联系。询价时建议同时提供姓名、公司、联系邮箱、设备或应用、轴径d、座孔或外径D、宽度b、介质、温度、压力、速度、材料要求和数量。

Ausome Seals 常见问题｜你们的价格怎么样？产品多少钱？
公司资料没有公开统一价格表，不能编造单价或声称一定比其他供应商便宜。油封多按型号或订货号、尺寸、材料、结构、工况、数量和定制要求核价。客户可将需求发送到support@ausomeseals.com；为获得有效报价，应提供d×D×b尺寸、介质、温度、压力、速度、材料、数量以及图纸或样品信息。

Ausome Seals FAQ | How long has the company been established? When was it founded?
The currently published company information does not provide a verifiable legal incorporation year, so 11 years must not be presented as the age of the company. What the material confirms is 11 years of experience with large steel rolling-mill equipment seals. Confirm the legal founding year through support@ausomeseals.com or WhatsApp +86 137-7661-6519.

Ausome Seals FAQ | Which OEM manufacturers has the company worked with?
Published company information states long-term OEM supply relationships with CISDI and CFHI. Do not infer or disclose other customer relationships that are not included in the published material.

Ausome Seals FAQ | How can I contact the company?
Email support@ausomeseals.com or use WhatsApp +86 137-7661-6519. For a quotation, include name, company, contact email, equipment or application, shaft diameter d, housing or outside diameter D, width b, medium, temperature, pressure, speed, material requirements and quantity.

Ausome Seals FAQ | What are your prices? How much does a seal cost?
The published material contains no universal price list, so the assistant must not invent a price or claim that every product is cheaper than competitors. Pricing depends on the model or order code, dimensions, material, profile, operating conditions, quantity and customization. Send d × D × b, medium, temperature, pressure, speed, material, quantity and any drawing or sample details to support@ausomeseals.com for a quotation.
